tasks.title: Implement GET /history endpoint
tasks.description: Create src/historyHandler.ts and export an Express Router. Implement the GET /history route: call C-4 getAllChecks() and respond HTTP 200 with the returned array. The array may be empty — an empty array must return HTTP 200 [], not 404. No query parameters, filtering, or pagination.
done_criteria: src/historyHandler.ts exists and exports an Express Router
GET /history calls getAllChecks() and returns HTTP 200 with the array

tasks.title: Implement GET /history/:id endpoint with validation and 404 handling
tasks.description: In src/historyHandler.ts, add the GET /history/:id route. Parse req.params.id with parseInt(req.params.id, 10). If the result is NaN or less than 1, respond HTTP 400 { error: 'id must be a positive integer' }. Otherwise call C-4 getCheckById(id): if null respond HTTP 404 { error: 'Check not found' }, otherwise respond HTTP 200 with the record object. Do not transform or reformat any fields.
done_criteria: GET /history/:id with non-integer :id returns HTTP 400 { error: 'id must be a positive integer' }
GET /history/:id with valid id and no matching record returns HTTP 404 { error: 'Check not found' }
GET /history/:id with valid id and matching record returns HTTP 200 with the record
No fields are transformed or reformatted
